title: 2024, Bluffdale City Council Meeting Agenda 08-14-2024 amended

votes.motion: Council Member Wilding moved to APPROVE the July 16, 2024, City Council Meeting Minutes, with changes. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE the Meeting Agenda as modified. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the City Council

votes.motion: Council Member Austin moved to APPROVE the Consent Agenda. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to AMEND Motion made by Council Member Austin that Resolution 2024-58 - Renaming Fire Station 92 be tabled until the September 11, 2024, City Council Meeting at which time Todd Sheeran and the District Attorney will present the facts of the case. Council Member Austin seconded the motion

Vote on Amended Motion to TABLE Resolution 2024-58- Renaming Fire Station 92 until the September 11, 2024: Council Member Austin-Yes, Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Wilding-Yes, Council Member Crockett-No

Council Member Crockett moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2024-17 - Adoption of the West Traverse Mountain Compatibility Area Study as Bluffdale's Compatible Use Plan for Areas within 5,000 Feet of Camp Williams, in Accordance with UCA 10-9a-537. Council Member Austin seconded the motion
Council Member Crockett moved to ADJOURN. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council
